ordering.basis: The D2b freeze names fresh-process read-only adoption first among later freezes.
ordering.correction: The retained image is not self-sufficient for dual-stream adoption because it stores CBOR but not the independently generated JSON bytes.
ordering.this_slice: Read-only classification and integrity inspection of the retained D2b/v2 image.
later: D3 fresh disjoint publisher storing both exact canonical JSON and exact canonical CBOR
D3b genuine restart adoption of that self-sufficient dual-stream image
bipartite graph and domain-separated Merkle commitment

retained_format_fact.consequence: Exact v2 bytes can prove a canonical-CBOR/scalar join only. They cannot prove continuity of H4-C's independently produced JSON stream or restore the original owner/lease.

closed_input_surface.held_root: Canonical absolute 0700 effective-uid-owned directory opened O_RDONLY|O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC and held under nonblocking shared flock.

descriptor_and_byte_contract.final_open: descriptor-rooted fixed C wrapper with O_RDONLY|O_NONBLOCK|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC
joins: held root to named root before classification
named final lstat to opened final fstat
bounded pread through exact size plus explicit EOF
opened final metadata stable after read
inventory exact after read and reconstruction
named final to held final vnode and complete metadata
held root to named root at terminal observation

sqlite_and_cbor_contract.deserialize: copy retained bytes into SQLite-owned read-only in-memory image
checks: SQLite header and page count exact
indexed scalar storage classes and values exact
canonical CBOR strict decode and identical re-encode
decoded CBOR semantics equal indexed scalars

required_tests: valid D2b image classifies CBOR-only and JSON-missing without admission
wrong mode, hard link and misaligned or oversized final
SQLite header, schema, row, indexed scalar, CBOR and semantic corruption
root rebound and final replacement during inspection
sequential copies and concurrent calls have one terminal winner
production binary excludes test factory, fault hooks and diagnostic canaries
hard_stops: Do not call a v2 result adopted, admitted, reconstructed dual-stream, H4-entered or authoritative.
Do not derive JSON from CBOR and relabel it as the independently retained JSON stream.
Do not migrate, rewrite, rename, clean, repair or delete any retained v2 namespace.
Do not add a production path loader, store mint, H3 mint, UI action, process, VM, network or Gate-E transition.
Do not fold D3 writer/schema changes, graph/Merkle work, crash cuts or distribution into this allowlist.
nonclaims: A new XCTest object is not a genuinely fresh operating-system process.
Descriptor and named-path joins prove the inspected interval, not continuity to D2b publication before inspector admission.
Advisory flock does not exclude same-euid, root or Full-Disk-Access mutation.
Read-only calls may cause filesystem-managed access-time bookkeeping.
No authenticity, anti-replay, rollback resistance, crash/power-loss recovery, constrained-I/O behavior, encryption, snapshot exclusion or secure deletion is proven.
This freeze neither enters nor completes H4, changes Gate E, evaluates a Prime candidate, validates distribution nor mints scientific authority.
